title: Degraded checkout
description: PagerDuty alert: error budget burn on orders-api; 12.3% of requests failing at peak and some requests timing out.
root_cause_detail: A traffic surge (~2.1x normal) exceeded the capacity of the inventory-service connection pool (max 25); requests waited for connections until timeout.
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in inventory-service logs
inventory-service p95 latency rises from ~18ms to ~828ms
inventory-service memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
request_rate on inventory-service rises ~2.7x before saturation
resolution: Scaled out inventory-service, raised the pool size within the database max_connections budget and added rate limiting for campaign traffic.
